name: Imouto no Otomari Kai
source: My parents are traveling and leaving my tsundere little sister to me. I was expecting a nice time alone with my sister but instead she invites a bunch of her friends over. No, wait... Could this be even more fun?
translation: My parents are traveling and leaving my tsundere little sister to me. I was expecting a nice time alone with my sister but instead she invites a bunch of her friends over. No, wait... Could this be even more fun?
